title: Meadow Overlook
description: Climb from meadow through a wooded rise to cliffs and a broad overlook, then descend into a new valley. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The low meadow
Follow the weight as it swings away.

The wooded rise
Follow the weight as it swings away.

The cliff terraces
Follow the weight as it swings away.

The meadow overlook
Follow the weight as it swings away.

Into the new valley
Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The low meadow
rooms.lesson: Follow the trail towards the wooded rise. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The wooded rise
rooms.lesson: Rise through the shaded tree terraces. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The cliff terraces
rooms.lesson: Reverse around the cliff and climb to its top. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The meadow overlook
rooms.lesson: The whole valley lies beneath the broad terrace. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: Into the new valley
rooms.lesson: Follow the far side into a different landscape. Follow the weight as it swings away.
